note: Local interface inventory; this does not replace any upstream/downstream payload schema.

bundle.writes: data-only collection JSON; never invokes a consumer

stats.writes: may initialize an empty collector stage; not a read-only command

http-collect.fetch: optional, separately permitted HTTP path; not verified by this audit

source_plan.registry_sha256_if_present: SHA-256(canonical JSON of the entire sources array), checked before selection
source_plan.legacy_minimal_plan: format/sources-only plans remain accepted; absence of registry_sha256 is not a verified registry checksum
source_plan.selected_source: exactly one source_id; existing file/HTTP source profile; returned without normalization
source_plan.review_freshness: existing source profile requires timezone-aware policy.reviewed_at within the past 31 days; no automatic renewal
source_plan.authority: ssr-knowledge central source registry; the exported plan and its hash are not an authorization signature

collection.canonical_json: sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8, Unicode preserved, NaN/Infinity rejected
collection.bundle_id: SHA-256 of canonical packet excluding bundle_id
collection.config_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact original source configuration; no URL/policy normalization
collection.time: timezone-aware capture and observation, observed_at >= captured_at, no more than 60 seconds in the future; not a page update date
collection.oversize: error before export directory/file creation; staged original retained; no truncation

browser_receipt.binding: exact central original_url, raw hash and observed capture time; not a signature or permission grant
browser_receipt.reobservation: packet captured_at matches the selected receipt; the immutable snapshot row's original capture time is retained

native_web.authority: fixed synthetic source; loopback Host, same Origin and session token; not a general user/record ACL service
native_web.execution: handler -> intake_file -> StageLedger.bundle -> new read-only SQLite connection
native_web.browser_acceptance: blocked; real default-browser opening/interaction evidence is required separately

module_boundaries.source_plan: source_from_plan validates external plan input; cli.source_from_plan remains an alias
module_boundaries.file_intake: trusted validated source + explicitly permitted UTF-8 file -> staged document; no network/LLM
module_boundaries.stage: collector-only SQLite and collection exporter; no knowledge entries
module_boundaries.http_collection: existing pure extractors/validators plus optional transport; transport unchanged by audit
module_boundaries.collector_lab: fixed synthetic adapter; arbitrary paths, policies, commands and endpoints rejected
